title: late so often my boss stopped asking why.
summary: He opens a cafe at seven and was late so often his boss stopped asking why: the alarm and the boss's texts went off at six, he snoozed in his sleep, missed the bus and worked half asleep. The problem was never hearing the alarm, it was that turning it off took one tap. Now it won't stop until he does 10 push-ups, walks 50 steps or shakes his phone 40 times, and he's the one unlocking the shop.
